values.goal: Allow a prepared Bound issue to become a complete implementation plan using typed semantic operations only.
values.required_outcome: Every structured SIP, STP, SPP, VPP, and SRP planning collection needed for authorized Bound replanning is replaceable through card-owned, generation-aware, digest-guarded, atomic, audited operations, with #5337 conversion proof.
declared_scope: csdlc-v2 semantic operation contracts and authorization
atomic card regeneration and cross-card acceptance validation
focused and end-to-end typed replanning tests
authority_boundary: typed C-SDLC v2 binaries are the sole lifecycle authority
semantic operations own card mutation and rendered Markdown remains derived
ADL owner tools provide repository and GitHub truth
